title: Interpret a credit curve
outcome: Interpret a credit curve as the term structure of standard-contract marks at quoted tenors together with the survival curve fitted to them, and distinguish a tenor-by-tenor change of quotation from a fit of one hazard term structure.
misconceptions: Converting each tenor's quote to an upfront with the standard converter produces one consistent survival curve.
A par spread read from a fitted term structure must equal the tenor's market-standard quote.
